text:
claire: Quick idea — instead of a single deep-benchmarks webinar, what if we do a 45-min "mini-series" episode focused on developer playbooks: 'Ship LLM features: cost, latency, and fallbacks' ? short, tactical, lots of demos.
evan: I like the playbooks angle. narrower than 'serving at scale' and easier to pitch to product-led devs. who would we want as speakers?
dave: +1. Recommend 1 PM (product lead) + 1 infra/serving eng + 1 customer case study. keeps it practical.
mira: customer ask: someone who has real infra constraints (SLA + budget). I can ping a customer who did a Dedicated rollout.
claire: cool. speaker shortlist so far: Priya (Platform PM), Jonah (Runtime Eng), + Mira's customer. Alex - can you check Jonah availability (internal) and estimate rehearsal slots?
alex: Jonah is available week of May 15. I can block 2 rehearsal slots (tech check + run-through). Mira — can you confirm customer by EOD Wed?
mira: Confirmed — customer okay to join as a panelist, prefers live Q&A for 10 mins.
sarah: For abstracts, propose two short variants: 1) Dev-centric (how we cut inference cost 40% without losing quality) 2) Ops-centric (routing, fallbacks, SLA playbook). We can A/B test the landing copy.
dave: Love A/B. Also recommend a 3-slide 'what to expect' for speakers to keep demos consistent.
claire: Draft run-of-show (45m):```00:00-00:02 intro + house rules00:02-00:12 Priya demo: cost-aware batching + config00:12-00:22 Jonah demo: routing, KV cache, graceful fallback00:22-00:30 customer case: migration and SLA outcomes00:30-00:38 panel QA (hosted)00:38-00:43 lightning tips + product call-to-action00:43-00:45 wrap + CTA (signup/trial)```
evan: Can we shorten demos to 8-9 mins each and leave 12 mins for live ops Q&A? customers ask a lot of infra questions.
claire: fine — shift timings: demos 9 min each, customer 6 min, QA 15 min. I'll update slide.
alex: Rehearsal plan: Tech check 30m (audio/video+demo infra) + Full run 45m. Need speaker availability and a rehearsal token for load testing.
mira: Customer wants a pre-call to coordinate talking points. I'll set that up.
sarah: Marketing asks: abstract + 3 subject lines + 2 CTAs by Friday. Also need a 20s promo clip request to demand gen.
dave: Can Ops provide a sample prompt + expected output to use in demo tests? Jonah — can you share a stable prompt set?
jonah: (joined thread) sharing prompt set link: https://internal/rdw/prompt-sets/mini-series — use the 'e2e-cost' folder. Note: use quantized model variant for demos to be stable.
claire: thanks. event-bot: Registrations: 12 signed up (pre-announcement seed).
evan: Good signal. Next steps: Claire to own run-of-show updates, Sarah to write abstracts and subject lines, Alex to schedule rehearsals, Mira to coordinate customer calls, Jonah to share prompts and env, Dave to create speaker 3-slide template. I can own follow-ups to make sure rehearsals happen.
claire: I'll post final abstract + speaker slide template tomorrow morning. thumbs up emoji :thumbsup:
